title.zh: 卷二十 本紀第二十 徽宗二
title.raw: 卷二十 本紀第二十 徽宗二 Volume 20 Annals 20: Huizong 2

sentences.zh: 四年春正月庚午朔，改熙河蘭會路為熙河蘭湟路。

translations.literal: Chongning 4, spring, first month, gengwu new moon: Xihe-Lan-Hui circuit was renamed Xihe-Lan-Huang circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Chongning 4, spring, gengwu new moon: Xihe-Lan-Hui circuit became Xihe-Lan-Huang.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，築溪哥城。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Xige city was fortified.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the court fortified Xige.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔察諸路監司貪虐者論其罪。

translations.literal: Day renchen: an edict ordered investigation of circuit intendants and supervisors who were greedy and cruel; their crimes were to be judged.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Huizong ordered greedy and cruel circuit supervisors tried for their crimes.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔京畿路改置轉運使、提點刑獄官。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: an edict reorganized transport commissioners and judicial commissioners in the capital circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the capital circuit gained new transport and judicial commissioners.

sentences.zh: 蔡卞罷。

translations.literal: Cai Bian was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Bian left office.

sentences.zh: 立武學法。

translations.literal: Military academy regulations were established.
translations.idiomatic: The court set military academy law.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，秦鳳蕃落獻邦、潘、疊三州。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Qin-Feng tribal peoples offered the three prefectures Bang, Pan, and Die.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Qin-Feng tribes surrendered Bang, Pan, and Die.

sentences.zh: 以內侍童貫為熙河蘭湟、秦鳳路經略安撫制置使。

translations.literal: The eunuch Tong Guan was made commissioner for pacification, comfort, and disposal on Xihe-Lan-Huang and Qin-Feng circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Tong Guan, a palace eunuch, took Xihe-Lan-Huang and Qin-Feng as pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，築禦謀城。

translations.literal: Second month, day yisi: Yumu city was fortified.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yisi: Yumu was fortified.

sentences.zh: 己酉，置親衛、勳衛、翊衛郎、中郎等官，以勳戚近臣之兄弟子孫有官者試充。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: offices of Personal Guard, Merit Guard, and Assist Guard outer and middle commanders were established; sons and grandsons of meritorious and close officials who already held office were tried for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, three guard commands were opened to sons and grandsons of the meritorious and the imperial kin who already held rank.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以張康國知樞密院事，兵部尚書劉逵同知樞密院事，吏部尚書何執中為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Zhang Kangguo was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Minister of War Liu Kui was made co-director; Minister of Personnel He Zhizhong was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Zhang Kangguo headed Military Affairs, Liu Kui shared the bureau, and He Zhizhong took the left vice directorship.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，班方田法。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the equal-field law was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the equal-field law went out to the circuits.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔西邊用兵能招納羌人者，與斬級同賞。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: an edict on the western frontier—those who could recruit Qiang were rewarded like men who took heads.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, western commanders who won Qiang allies won the same bounty as for kills.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，升趙州為慶源軍。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Zhao prefecture was elevated to Qingyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Zhao became Qingyuan Army.

sentences.zh: 甲子，雨雹。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, hail struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，改三衛郎為侍郎。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the Three Guards outer commanders were renamed Vice Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Three Guards outer commanders became Vice Ministers.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬申，復元豐銓試斷按法。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day renshen: the Yuanfeng examination and case-adjudication method was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, renshen: Yuanfeng examination and case law returned.

sentences.zh: 令州縣仿尚書六曹分六案。

translations.literal: An edict ordered prefectures and counties to imitate the Six Boards of the Department of State Affairs with six desks.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties were to mirror the Six Boards with six desks each.

sentences.zh: 甲申，置陝西、河東、河北、京西監，鑄當二夾錫鐵錢。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: supervisors were placed in Shaanxi, Hedong, Hebei, and Jingxi to mint adulterated iron cash of nominal value two.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Shaanxi, Hedong, Hebei, and Jingxi gained mints for tin-adulterated two-cash iron coin.

sentences.zh: 己丑，禦端門，受趙懷德降，授感德軍節度使，封安化郡王。

translations.literal: Day jichou: at the Meridian Gate the court received Zhao Huai's surrender; he was made military commissioner of Gande Army and enfeoffed Prince of Anhua.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, at the Meridian Gate Zhao Huai surrendered and took Gande command and the title Prince of Anhua.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，曲赦熙河蘭湟路。

translations.literal: Day renchen: a partial amnesty in Xihe-Lan-Huang circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Xihe-Lan-Huang won a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅，置青海馬監。

translations.literal: Third month, day renyin: the Qinghai Horse Pasture was established.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renyin: the Qinghai stud farm was founded.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以趙挺之為尚書右僕射兼中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Zhao Tingzhi was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Zhao Tingzhi became Right Vice Director and Chancellery vice director.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔建王口砦為懷遠軍。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: an edict established Wangkou stockade as Huaiyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Wangkou stockade was raised to Huaiyuan Army.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，令呂惠卿致仕。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Lü Huiqing was ordered to retire.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Lü Huiqing was sent home.

sentences.zh: 戊午，復銀州。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Yin prefecture was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Yin prefecture returned to the Song.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔州縣屬鄉聚徒教授者，非經書、子、史毋習。

translations.literal: Day yichou: an edict—county tutors teaching in village assemblies might study only the classics, the Masters, and histories.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, village tutors were confined to classics, Masters, and histories—nothing else.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，牂牁、夜郎首領以地降。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Zangke and Yelang chiefs surrendered land.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Zangke and Yelang chiefs ceded territory.

sentences.zh: 是月，夏人攻塞門砦。

translations.literal: That month, Western Xia attacked Saimen stockade.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Xia struck Saimen stockade.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，遼遣蕭良來，為夏人求還侵地及退兵。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinwei: Liao sent Xiao Liang to seek return of seized land and withdrawal of troops for Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, xinwei: Liao sent Xiao Liang to recover Xia's lost ground and a Song pullback.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，夏人攻臨宗砦。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Western Xia attacked Linzong stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Xia hit Linzong stockade.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔諸路走馬承受毋得預軍政及邊事。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: an edict—for circuit couriers on horseback, no meddling in military government or frontier affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, frontier couriers were barred from army and border business.

sentences.zh: 己丑，夏人寇順寧砦，鄜延第二副將劉延慶擊破之；

translations.literal: Day jichou: Western Xia raided Shunning stockade; Liu Yanqing, second deputy of Yan-Yan, routed them;
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Xia raided Shunning; Liu Yanqing, second Yan-Yan deputy, broke them;

sentences.zh: 復攻湟州北蕃市城，知州辛叔獻等擊卻之。

translations.literal: they again attacked the northern Fan market town of Huang prefecture; Prefect Xin Shuxian and others drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: then struck Huang's northern Fan market; Prefect Xin Shuxian and others beat them back.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，除黨人父兄子弟之禁。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wushen: the ban on office for kin of faction men was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, wushen: fathers, brothers, and sons of Yuanyou men could serve again.

sentences.zh: 壬子，遣林攄報聘於遼。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Lin Shu was sent on a return mission of courtesy to Liao.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Lin Shu carried the court's thanks to Liao.

sentences.zh: 賜張繼先號虛靜先生。

translations.literal: Zhang Jixian was granted the style-name Master of Empty Stillness.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jixian was styled Master of Empty Stillness.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，罷轉運司檢察鉤考法。

translations.literal: Day guichou: the transport commissioners' inspection and audit method was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, transport inspection and audit ended.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，命官分部決獄。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: officials were ordered to divide and decide cases by section.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, officials were sent out in sections to settle cases.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，復解池鹽。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingzi: Jiechi salt works were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, bingzi: Jiechi salt returned to state hands.

sentences.zh: 占城入貢。

translations.literal: Champa sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Champa brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，罷陝西、河東力役。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: corvée labor in Shaanxi and Hedong was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Shaanxi and Hedong corvée was ended.

sentences.zh: 甲申，曲赦熙河、陝西、河東、京西路。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: a partial amnesty in Xihe, Shaanxi, Hedong, and Jingxi circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Xihe, Shaanxi, Hedong, and Jingxi won partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 戊子，趙挺之罷。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Zhao Tingzhi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Zhao Tingzhi left office.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙申朔，罷三京國子監官，各置司業一員。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingshen new moon: the Three Capital Directorate of Education offices were abolished; each circuit gained one Vice Director of Studies.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, bingshen new moon: Three Capital Directorate schools were cut; each circuit got one Vice Director of Studies.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，置熒惑壇。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: the Mars Altar was established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the Mars Altar was founded.

sentences.zh: 置四輔郡，以潁昌府為南輔，襄邑縣為東輔，鄭州為西輔，澶州為北輔。

translations.literal: The Four Assist circuits were established: Yingchang prefecture as Southern Assist, Xiangyi county as Eastern Assist, Zheng prefecture as Western Assist, and Cao prefecture as Northern Assist.
translations.idiomatic: Four Assist circuits were named: Yingchang south, Xiangyi east, Zheng west, Cao north.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔奪元祐輔臣墳寺。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: an edict seized Yuanyou chief ministers' tomb temples.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Huizong seized Yuanyou ministers' tomb temples.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，還上書流人。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: exiles who had submitted memorials were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, memorial-writing exiles came home.

sentences.zh: 戶部尚書曾孝廣坐錢帛皆闕，出知杭州。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue Zeng Xiaoguang, because money and silk were both short, was sent out as prefect of Hang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Xiaoguang, Minister of Revenue, left for Hang prefecture—his treasury was empty of coin and silk.

sentences.zh: 八月戊辰，以德妃王氏為淑妃。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuchen: Virtuous Consort Wang was advanced to Pure Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, wuchen: Virtuous Consort Wang became Pure Consort.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以王、江、古州歸順，置提舉溪洞官二員，改懷遠軍為平州。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: because Wang, Jiang, and Gu prefectures submitted, two superintendents for stream and cave districts were appointed; Huaiyuan Army was changed to Ping prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Wang, Jiang, and Gu submitted; two stream-and-cave superintendents were named and Huaiyuan became Ping.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以東輔為拱州。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the Eastern Assist was made Gong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the Eastern Assist became Gong prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲申，奠九鼎于九成宮。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the Nine Cauldrons were set in place at the Palace of Nine Completenesses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the Nine Cauldrons were set in the Palace of Nine Completenesses.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詣宮酌獻。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: the emperor went to the palace and poured libations.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Huizong poured libations at the palace.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，賜新樂名《大晟》，置府建官。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the new music was named Dasheng; an office and staff were established for it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the new music was titled Dasheng and given its own bureau.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣劉正夫使遼。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Liu Zhengfu was sent as envoy to Liao.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Liu Zhengfu went to Liao.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥，赦天下。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jihai: amnesty for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jihai: the empire was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔元祐人貶謫者以次徙近地，惟不得至畿輔。

translations.literal: Day yisi: an edict—Yuanyou men in exile were to be moved in stages nearer home, but not into the capital circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Yuanyou exiles were shifted stage by stage toward home—never into the capital circuit.

sentences.zh: 詔京畿、三路保甲並于農隙時教閱。

translations.literal: An edict: capital-circuit and Three-Roads baojia were to drill together in the gaps between farm seasons.
translations.idiomatic: Capital and Three-Roads baojia were ordered to drill in the slack between harvests.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賜上舍生三十五人及第。

translations.literal: Day yimao: thirty-five upper-academy students were granted the jinshi degree.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, thirty-five upper-academy men took jinshi.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔自今非宰臣毋得除特進。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: an edict—from now on none but chief ministers might receive Special Advanced rank.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, only chief ministers could be made Special Advanced.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，自七月雨，至是月不止。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: rain had fallen since the seventh month and did not stop through this month.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: rain since the seventh month still had not ceased.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以左、右司所編紹聖、元符以來申明斷例班天下，刑名例班刑部、大理司。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the clarified precedents and adjudication cases compiled since Shaosheng and Yuanfu by the Left and Right Bureaus were promulgated empire-wide; penal precedents were promulgated to the Ministry of Justice and the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Shaosheng and Yuanfu legal clarifications went empire-wide; penal models went to Justice and the Court of Review.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，升武岡縣為軍。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Wugang county was elevated to an army.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Wugang county became an army.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔上書進士未獲者，限百日自陳免罪。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: an edict—jinshi candidates who had submitted memorials but not been granted office might, within a hundred days, confess and be spared punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, memorial-writing jinshi still without office had a hundred days to confess and escape penalty.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: Day renchen: a black spot appeared in the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, a sunspot showed.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，安定郡王世雍薨。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuxu: Prince Shiyong of Anding commandery died.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wuxu: Prince Shiyong of Anding died.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，置諸路提舉學事官。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: circuit superintendents of studies were established on every route.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, every circuit gained a superintendent of studies.

sentences.zh: 己未，章惇卒。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Zhang Dun died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Zhang Dun died.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，升拱州為保慶軍。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guiyou: Gong prefecture was elevated to Baoqing Army.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guiyou: Gong became Baoqing Army.

sentences.zh: 甲申，分平州置允州、格州。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: from Ping prefecture, Yun and Ge prefectures were split off.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Yun and Ge were carved from Ping.

sentences.zh: 是歲，蘇、湖、秀三州水，賜乏食者粟。

translations.literal: That year, Su, Hu, and Xiu prefectures suffered flood; grain was granted to those without food.
translations.idiomatic: That year flood drowned Su, Hu, and Xiu; the hungry received grain.

sentences.zh: 泰州禾生穞。

translations.literal: In Taizhou, grain grew double ears on one stalk.
translations.idiomatic: Taizhou reported grain with double ears on one stalk.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月戊戌，彗出西方，其長竟天。

translations.literal: Chongning 5, spring, first month, day wuxu: a comet appeared in the west, its tail spanning the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Chongning 5, spring, wuxu: a comet rose in the west, tail across the heavens.

sentences.zh: 庚子，復置江、湖、淮、浙常平都倉。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the Jiang-Huai-Huai-Zhe ever-normal granaries were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Jiang-Lake-Huai-Zhe ever-normal granaries returned.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以吳居厚為門下侍郎，劉逵為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Wu Juhou was made Vice Director of the Chancellery; Liu Kui was made Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Wu Juhou took the Chancellery and Liu Kui the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以星變，避殿損膳，詔求直言闕失。

translations.literal: Day yisi: because of the omen, the emperor left the hall, reduced his meals, and issued an edict seeking blunt speech on omissions.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the comet drove Huizong from the hall, cut his table, and called for blunt counsel.

sentences.zh: 毀《元祐黨人碑》。

translations.literal: The Yuanyou faction stele was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuanyou faction stele was torn down.

sentences.zh: 復謫者仕籍，自今言者勿復彈糾。

translations.literal: Office registers of the re-banished were restored; from now on no one was to impeach them again.
translations.idiomatic: Re-banished men regained their registers; impeachment of them was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 丁未，太白晝見，赦天下，除黨人一切之禁。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Venus was seen by day; amnesty for the empire; every ban on faction men was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Venus shone by day; the empire was pardoned and every faction ban ended.

sentences.zh: 權罷方田。

translations.literal: The equal-field system was suspended for the time being.
translations.idiomatic: Equal-field work was halted for now.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔侍從官奏封事。

translations.literal: Day wushen: an edict ordered attendant officials to submit sealed memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, attendants were to file sealed memorials.

sentences.zh: 己酉，罷諸州歲貢供奉物。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: the annual tribute of tribute goods from every prefecture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, annual prefectural tribute to the palace ended.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔崇甯以來左降者，各以存歿稍復其官，盡還諸徙者。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: an edict—those demoted since Chongning, living or dead, were to have office partly restored by degree; all exiles were fully returned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Chongning demotions were partly reversed, living or dead, and every exile sent home.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，禦殿復膳。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the emperor returned to the hall and restored his meals.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Huizong returned to the hall and full rations.

sentences.zh: 壬子，罷圜土法。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the walled-prison law was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the walled-prison law ended.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，罷書、畫、算、醫四學。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: the four schools of calligraphy, painting, calculation, and medicine were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, calligraphy, painting, calculation, and medicine schools closed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，復書、畫、算學。

translations.literal: Day renxu: the schools of calligraphy, painting, and calculation were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, calligraphy, painting, and calculation schools reopened.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子朔，詔監司條奏民間疾苦。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiazi new moon: an edict ordered circuit supervisors to memorialize the people's hardships item by item.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiazi new moon: circuit supervisors were to list the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，蔡京罷為開府儀同三司、中太一宮使。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Cai Jing was dismissed to Grand Master of the Palace with the same ceremonial rank as the Three Excellencies and made commissioner of the Central Grand Unity Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Cai Jing left the council for Grand Master of the Palace and commissioner of Central Grand Unity.

sentences.zh: 以觀文殿大學士趙挺之為特進、尚書右僕射兼中書侍郎。

translations.literal: University Fellow Zhao Tingzhi was made Special Advanced, Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Tingzhi, University Fellow, became Special Advanced, Right Vice Director, and Chancellery vice director.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔翰林學士、兩省官及館閣自今並除進士出身人。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: an edict—from now Hanlin academicians, officials of both provinces, and the Archive were all to be appointed from men of jinshi origin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Hanlin, both provinces, and the Archive were reserved for jinshi men.

sentences.zh: 壬申，省內外冗官，罷醫官兼宮觀者。

translations.literal: Day renshen: redundant offices inside and outside the capital were cut; medical officials who also held palace appointments were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, redundant posts were cut and medical officers holding palace sinecures were removed.

sentences.zh: 蒲甘國入貢。

translations.literal: Pagan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Pagan brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以前後所降御筆手詔模印成冊，班之中外。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: imperial brush edicts and hand edicts issued before and after were printed into volumes and promulgated within and without the court.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Huizong's brush and hand edicts were printed in volumes for court and provinces.

sentences.zh: 州縣不遵奉者，監司按劾，監司推行不盡者，諸司互察之。

translations.literal: Where prefectures and counties did not obey, supervisors were to impeach; where supervisors did not enforce fully, the ministries were to investigate one another.
translations.idiomatic: Disobedient counties faced supervisor impeachment; lax supervisors faced cross-ministry audit.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑，停免兩浙水災州郡夏稅。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingchou: summer tax in Zhe circuits flooded by water was suspended and remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, dingchou: summer tax was waived in flood-struck Zhe circuits.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，班《紀元曆》。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingwei: the Jiyuan Calendar was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, dingwei: the Jiyuan Calendar went out.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，封子栩為魯國公。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the son Xu was enfeoffed Duke of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the son Xu was enfeoffed Duke of Lu.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，罷辟舉，盡復元豐選法。

translations.literal: Day yimao: special recruitment was abolished and the Yuanfeng selection law was fully restored.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, special recruitment ended and Yuanfeng selection rules returned in full.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，立諸路監司互察法，庇匿不舉者罪之，仍令御史台糾劾。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guihai: a mutual-inspection law for circuit supervisors was established; those who shielded and failed to report were punished, and the Censorate was ordered to impeach.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, guihai: circuit supervisors gained mutual inspection; shielding brought punishment and Censorate impeachment.

sentences.zh: 改格州為從州。

translations.literal: Ge prefecture was changed to a subordinate prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ge prefecture was reduced to a subordinate prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔求隱逸之士，令監司審核保奏，其緣私者，御史察之。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: an edict sought reclusive scholars; circuit supervisors were to examine and recommend them, and the Censorate was to investigate private favoritism.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, recluses were sought; supervisors were to vet and recommend them while the Censorate checked favoritism.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔輔臣條具東南守備策。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: an edict ordered chief ministers to draw up plans for defending the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, chief ministers were told to draft southeast defense plans.

sentences.zh: 壬申，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day renshen: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚寅朔，日當食不虧。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengyin new moon: an eclipse was due but did not occur.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, gengyin new moon: an eclipse was due but did not occur.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔改明年元。

translations.literal: Day renyin: an edict changed the next year’s reign title.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the next year’s reign title was changed.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑，河南府嘉禾與芝草同本生。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinchou: in Henan prefecture auspicious grain and fungus grew on one stalk.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, xinchou: Henan reported auspicious grain and fungus on one stalk.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，升澶州為開德府。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jimao: Cao prefecture was promoted to Kaide prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jimao: Cao prefecture became Kaide prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，降德音於開德府：減囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: a grace edict was issued in Kaide prefecture: prisoners’ sentences were reduced one degree and those below penal servitude were released.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Kaide received a grace edict cutting sentences one degree and freeing those below penal servitude.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，以向宗回為開府儀同三司，徙封安康郡王。

translations.literal: Second month, day renxu: Xiang Zonghui was made Grand Master of the Palace with the same ceremonial rank as the Three Excellencies and transferred to Prince of Ankang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, renxu: Xiang Zonghui became Grand Master of the Palace and Prince of Ankang.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以黎洞納土，曲赦廣西。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: because the Li cave peoples submitted territory, Guangxi received a partial amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Li cave submission brought a partial amnesty in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，復醫學。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the medical school was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the medical school reopened.

sentences.zh: 己卯，復行方田。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the equal-field system was again implemented.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, equal-field work resumed.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以平昌郡君韋氏為才人。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Lady Wei of Pingchang commandery was made Talented Lady.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Lady Wei of Pingchang became Talented Lady.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，趙挺之罷。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingyou: Zhao Tingzhi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, dingyou: Zhao Tingzhi left office.

sentences.zh: 以何執中為門下侍郎，鄧洵武為中書侍郎，梁子美為尚書左丞，吏部尚書朱諤為右丞。

translations.literal: He Zhizhong was made Vice Director of the Chancellery; Deng Xunwu Vice Director of the Secretariat; Liang Zimei Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Minister of Personnel Zhu E Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: He Zhizhong took the Chancellery, Deng Xunwu the Secretariat, Liang Zimei the left vice directorship, and Zhu E the right.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，立八行取士科。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: the Eight Conducts degree category was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the Eight Conducts degree category was opened.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，趙挺之卒。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Zhao Tingzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Zhao Tingzhi died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，以淑妃王氏為貴妃。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yichou: Gentle Consort Lady Wang was made Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, yichou: Gentle Consort Wang became Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，封子棫為楊國公。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jichou: the son Yi was enfeoffed Duke of Yang.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jichou: the son Yi was enfeoffed Duke of Yang.

sentences.zh: 朝散郎吳儲、承議郎吳侔坐與妖人張懷素謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: Court Gentleman Wu Chu and Court Gentleman for Discussion Wu Mou were executed for plotting rebellion with the sorcerer Zhang Huaisu.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Chu and Wu Mou were executed for plotting with the sorcerer Zhang Huaisu.

sentences.zh: 貶呂惠卿為祁州團練副使。

translations.literal: Lü Huiqing was demoted to deputy military commissioner of Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Huiqing was demoted to Qizhou deputy military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，鄧洵武罷。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Deng Xunwu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Deng Xunwu left office.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔班新樂於天下。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: an edict promulgated the new music throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the new court music was issued empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔自今凡總一路及監司之任，勿以元祐學術及異意人充選。

translations.literal: Day guimao: an edict—from now, in posts commanding a whole circuit or serving as circuit supervisor, men of Yuanyou learning or divergent views were not to be appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, circuit commanders and supervisors were barred from Yuanyou scholars and men of divergent views.

sentences.zh: 以安化蠻犯邊，益兵赴廣西討之。

translations.literal: Because the Anhua barbarians raided the frontier, troops were increased and sent to Guangxi to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: Anhua frontier raids brought more troops to Guangxi for punitive action.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，子構生。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the son Gou was born.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the son Gou was born.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，以梁子美為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiwei: Liang Zimei was made Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiwei: Liang Zimei became Secretariat vice director.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔景靈宮建僖祖殿室。

translations.literal: Day renxu: an edict ordered a hall for Ancestor Xizu built at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Jingling Palace was ordered to add a hall for Ancestor Xizu.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以黎人地為庭、孚二州。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Li people’s land was made the two prefectures Ting and Fu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Li lands became Ting and Fu prefectures.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，賜上舍生二十九人及第。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: twenty-nine Upper College students were granted passage.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, twenty-nine Upper College students passed the examination.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，朱諤卒。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Zhu E died.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Zhu E died.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以才人韋氏為婕妤。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Talented Lady Lady Wei was made Lady of Handsome Fairness.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Talented Lady Wei became Lady of Handsome Fairness.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙酉朔，伊、洛溢。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yiyou new moon: the Yi and Luo rivers overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yiyou new moon: the Yi and Luo flooded.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔括天下漏丁。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: an edict ordered an empire-wide search for unregistered adult males.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the court ordered an empire-wide search for unregistered adult males.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，班祭服於州郡。

translations.literal: Day renyin: sacrificial robes were promulgated to prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, sacrificial robes were issued to the prefectures.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，賢妃武氏薨。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Noble Consort Lady Wu died.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Noble Consort Wu died.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，曾布卒。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yimao: Zeng Bu died.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, yimao: Zeng Bu died.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，封子構為蜀國公。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: the son Gou was enfeoffed Duke of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the son Gou was enfeoffed Duke of Shu.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以戶部尚書徐處仁為尚書右丞，吏部尚書林攄同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Minister of Revenue Xu Churen was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Minister of Personnel Lin Shu was made co-director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Xu Churen became right vice director and Lin Shu co-director of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 己巳，降德音於淮、海、吳、楚二十六州：減囚罪一等，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day jisi: a grace edict was issued in twenty-six Huai, sea, Wu, and Chu prefectures: prisoners’ sentences were reduced one degree and those below exile were released.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, twenty-six Huai, sea, Wu, and Chu prefectures received a grace edict cutting sentences one degree and freeing those below exile.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，建顯烈觀于陳橋。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengyin: Xianlie Abbey was built at Chen Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, gengyin: Xianlie Abbey was built at Chen Bridge.

sentences.zh: 己酉，加上僖祖諡曰立道肇基積德起功懿文憲武睿和至孝皇帝，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Ancestor Xizu’s posthumous title was augmented as Emperor Who Established the Way, Founded the Basis, Accumulated Virtue, Raised Merit, Cultured Elegance, Majestic Martiality, Sagacious Harmony, and Utter Filiality; the court presented offerings at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Ancestor Xizu received a greatly augmented posthumous title and the court offered at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，饗太廟。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: the Ancestral Temple was feasted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the court feasted at the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，大饗明堂，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the Bright Hall was grandly sacrificed to; the realm was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the Bright Hall rites were held and the realm was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 升永興軍為大都督府。

translations.literal: Yongxing Army was promoted to a great metropolitan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yongxing Army was raised to a great metropolitan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 章綖坐冒法，竄海島。

translations.literal: Zhang Yuan, for violating the law, was banished to a sea island.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yuan was banished to a sea island for violating the law.

sentences.zh: 李景直等四人以上書觀望罪，並編管嶺南。

translations.literal: Li Jingzhi and three others, for the crime of fence-sitting in their memorials, were all registered and banished to Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingzhi and three others were banished to Lingnan for hedging in their memorials.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未，詔士有才武絕倫者，歲貢准文士上舍上等法。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiwei: an edict—scholars with peerless martial talent were to be nominated yearly by the same rules as Upper College literary men of the top grade.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jiwei: men of peerless martial talent were to be nominated yearly like top-grade Upper College scholars.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，蘇州地震。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Suzhou had an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Suzhou shook.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，貶張商英為安化軍節度副使。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Zhang Shangying was demoted to deputy military commissioner of Anhua Army.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Zhang Shangying was demoted to Anhua Army deputy military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己巳，大雨雹。

translations.literal: Day jisi: heavy hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, heavy hail fell.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙戌，以林攄為尚書左丞，資政殿學士鄭居中同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day bingxu: Lin Shu was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; University Fellow Zheng Juzhong was made co-director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, bingxu: Lin Shu became left vice director and Zheng Juzhong co-director of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔守令以戶口為殿最。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: an edict made household registers the chief criterion for grading prefects and magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, prefects and magistrates were graded chiefly by household registers.

sentences.zh: 升桂州為大都督府，鎮州為靖海軍節度。

translations.literal: Gui prefecture was promoted to a great metropolitan prefecture; Zhen prefecture became Jinghai Army command.
translations.idiomatic: Gui became a great metropolitan prefecture and Zhen became Jinghai Army command.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，禁用翡翠。

translations.literal: Day renyin: kingfisher feather ornament was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, kingfisher feather ornament was banned.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，升太原府、鄆州並為大都督府。

translations.literal: Day yisi: Taiyuan prefecture and Yan prefecture were both promoted to great metropolitan prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Taiyuan and Yan were both raised to great metropolitan prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子朔，日有食之，蔡京等以不及所當食分，率群臣稱賀。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renzi new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun; Cai Jing and others, claiming it did not reach the predicted degree, led the ministers in congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, renzi new moon: the sun was eclipsed; Cai Jing claimed it fell short of prediction and led ministers in congratulation.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，置符寶郎。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Talisman Keeper posts were established.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Talisman Keeper posts were established.

sentences.zh: 己巳，升瀛州為河間府、瀛海軍節度。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Ying prefecture was promoted to Hejian prefecture and Yinghai Army command.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Ying became Hejian prefecture and Yinghai Army command.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，南丹州刺史莫公佞降。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Mo Gongyun, prefect of Nandan, surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Nandan prefect Mo Gongyun surrendered.

sentences.zh: 徐處仁以母憂去位。

translations.literal: Xu Churen left office on account of his mother’s mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Churen left office to mourn his mother.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，以蔡京為太尉，進何執中以下官二等。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengyin: Cai Jing was made Grand Marshal; He Zhizhong and those below were advanced two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, gengyin: Cai Jing became Grand Marshal and He Zhizhong’s party rose two ranks.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以江甯、荊南、揚、杭、越、洪、福、潭、廣、桂並為帥府。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Jiangning, Jingnan, Yang, Hang, Yue, Hong, Fu, Tan, Guang, and Gui were all made marshal prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Jiangning, Jingnan, Yang, Hang, Yue, Hong, Fu, Tan, Guang, and Gui became marshal prefectures.

sentences.zh: 置黔南路。

translations.literal: Qiannan circuit was established.
translations.idiomatic: Qiannan circuit was established.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，置開封府府學。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the Kaifeng prefectural school was established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the Kaifeng prefectural school opened.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以婉容喬氏為賢妃。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Lady Qiao of Graceful Appearance was made Virtuous Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Lady Qiao of Graceful Appearance became Virtuous Consort.

sentences.zh: 開潩河。

translations.literal: The Bi River was opened.
translations.idiomatic: The Bi River canal was opened.

sentences.zh: 是歲，秦鳳旱。

translations.literal: That year Qin-Feng had drought.
translations.idiomatic: That year Qin-Feng suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 京東水，河溢，遣官振濟，貸被水戶租。

translations.literal: Jingdong had floods and the Yellow River overflowed; officials were sent to relieve distress and rent was lent to flood-struck households.
translations.idiomatic: Jingdong flooded and the Yellow River burst; relief officials went out and flood households received rent loans.

sentences.zh: 廬州雨豆。

translations.literal: Luzhou had a rain of beans.
translations.idiomatic: Luzhou reported beans raining from the sky.

sentences.zh: 汀、懷二州慶雲見。

translations.literal: Ting and Huai prefectures saw auspicious clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Ting and Huai saw auspicious clouds.

sentences.zh: 乾甯軍、同州黃河清。

translations.literal: At Qianning Army and Tong prefecture the Yellow River ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River ran clear at Qianning Army and Tong prefecture.

sentences.zh: 于闐、夏國入貢。

translations.literal: Khotan and Western Xia sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Khotan and Western Xia brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 涪州夷駱世葉、駱文貴內附。

translations.literal: The Yi of Fuzhou, Luo Shiye and Luo Wengui, submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzhou Yi leaders Luo Shiye and Luo Wengui submitted.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月壬子朔，受八寶於大慶殿，赦天下，文武進位一等。

translations.literal: Year 2, spring, first month, day renzi new moon: the Eight Treasures were received in Daqing Hall; the realm was pardoned and civil and military officials were advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Year 2, spring, renzi new moon: Daqing Hall received the Eight Treasures; the realm was pardoned and every official rose one rank.

sentences.zh: 蔡京表賀符瑞。

translations.literal: Cai Jing memorialized congratulating on the portents.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Jing memorialized to congratulate the portents.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以婉儀劉氏為德妃。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Lady Liu of Graceful Ceremony was made Virtuous Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Lady Liu of Graceful Ceremony became Virtuous Consort.

sentences.zh: 己未，蔡京進太師；

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Cai Jing was advanced to Grand Preceptor;
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Cai Jing became Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 加童貫節度使，仍宣撫。

translations.literal: Tong Guan was made a military commissioner and retained as Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Tong Guan became military commissioner and kept the pacification post.

sentences.zh: 庚申，進封魏王俁為燕王，鄧王偲為越王，並為太尉；

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Prince of Wei Hou was advanced to Prince of Yan and Prince of Deng Si to Prince of Yue, both made Grand Marshals;
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Prince of Wei Hou became Prince of Yan and Prince of Deng Si Prince of Yue, both Grand Marshal;

sentences.zh: 京兆郡王桓為定王，高密郡王楷為嘉王，並為司空；

translations.literal: Prince of Jingzhao commandery Huan was made Prince of Ding and Prince of Gaomi commandery Kai Prince of Jia, both made Sikong;
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jingzhao Huan became Prince of Ding and Prince of Gaomi Kai Prince of Jia, both Sikong;

sentences.zh: 吳國公樞為建安郡王，冀國公杞為文安郡王，楚國公栩為安康郡王，楊國公棫為濟陽郡王，蜀國公構為廣平郡王，並為開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Duke of Wu Shu was made Prince of Jian’an commandery, Duke of Ji Qi Prince of Wen’an commandery, Duke of Chu Xu Prince of Ankang commandery, Duke of Yang Yi Prince of Jiyang commandery, and Duke of Shu Gou Prince of Guangping commandery, all made Grand Masters of the Palace with the same ceremonial rank as the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Wu Shu became Prince of Jian’an, Duke of Ji Qi Prince of Wen’an, Duke of Chu Xu Prince of Ankang, Duke of Yang Yi Prince of Jiyang, and Duke of Shu Gou Prince of Guangping, all Grand Masters of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以神宗德妃宋氏、劉氏為淑妃，賢妃喬氏為德妃。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Shenzong’s Virtuous Consorts Lady Song and Lady Liu were made Gentle Consorts, and Worthy Consort Lady Qiao was made Virtuous Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Shenzong’s Virtuous Consorts Song and Liu became Gentle Consorts and Worthy Consort Qiao became Virtuous Consort.

sentences.zh: 庚午，徙封仲損為齊安郡王，仲禦為華陽郡王，孝騫為晉康郡王，孝參為豫章郡王，並開府儀同三司；

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Zhongsun was transferred to Prince of Qi’an commandery, Zhongyu to Prince of Huayang commandery, Xiaochuan to Prince of Jinkang commandery, and Xiaocan to Prince of Yuzhang commandery, all made Grand Masters of the Palace with the same ceremonial rank as the Three Excellencies;
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Zhongsun became Prince of Qi’an, Zhongyu Prince of Huayang, Xiaochuan Prince of Jinkang, and Xiaocan Prince of Yuzhang, all Grand Masters of the Palace;

sentences.zh: 封仲增為信安郡王，仲忽為普安郡王，仲癸為咸安郡王，仲僕為同安郡王，仲糜為淮安郡王。

translations.literal: Zhongzeng was enfeoffed Prince of Xin’an commandery, Zhonghu Prince of Pu’an commandery, Zhonggui Prince of Xian’an commandery, Zhongpu Prince of Tong’an commandery, and Zhongmi Prince of Huai’an commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongzeng became Prince of Xin’an, Zhonghu of Pu’an, Zhonggui of Xian’an, Zhongpu of Tong’an, and Zhongmi of Huai’an.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，徙封向宗回為漢東郡王，向宗良為開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Xiang Zonghui was transferred to Prince of Handong commandery and Xiang Zongliang made Grand Master of the Palace with the same ceremonial rank as the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Xiang Zonghui became Prince of Handong and Xiang Zongliang Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 仲損薨。

translations.literal: Zhongsun died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongsun died.

sentences.zh: 河東、北盜起。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in Hedong and the north.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits rose in Hedong and the north.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，置諸州曹掾官。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiashen: bureau-assistant posts were established in every prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiashen: every prefecture gained bureau-assistant posts.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔建徽猷閣，藏《哲宗禦集》，置學士、直學士、待制官。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: an edict ordered Huiyou Pavilion built to house the Collected Writings of Zhezong, with academicians, direct academicians, and attendant compilers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Huiyou Pavilion was ordered built for Zhezong’s collected writings, with academy and compiler posts.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以安德軍節度使錢景臻為開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Qian Jingzhen, military commissioner of Ande Army, was made Grand Master of the Palace with the same ceremonial rank as the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Ande military commissioner Qian Jingzhen became Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以婕妤韋氏為修容。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Lady Wei of Handsome Fairness was made Lady of Cultivated Countenance.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Lady Wei of Handsome Fairness became Lady of Cultivated Countenance.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，班《金籙靈寶道場儀范》於天下。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengshen: the Golden Register Spirit Treasure Ritual Canon was promulgated throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, gengshen: the Golden Register Spirit Treasure Ritual Canon was issued empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 甲子，封子材為魏國公。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: the son Cai was enfeoffed Duke of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the son Cai was enfeoffed Duke of Wei.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，封子模為鎮國公。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the son Mo was enfeoffed Duke of Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the son Mo was enfeoffed Duke of Zhen.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，賜上舍生十三人及第。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: thirteen Upper College students were granted passage.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, thirteen Upper College students passed the examination.

sentences.zh: 升乾寧軍為清州。

translations.literal: Qianning Army was promoted to Qing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Qianning Army was raised to Qing prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔監司歲舉所部郡守二人、縣令四人赴三省審察。

translations.literal: Edict: each year circuit commissioners were to nominate two prefects and four magistrates from their jurisdictions for review by the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: An edict required circuit commissioners yearly to send two prefects and four magistrates from their circuits to the Three Departments for review.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，復洮州。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiachen: Taozhou was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jiachen: Taozhou was recovered.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengxu new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, gengxu new moon: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 以復洮州功，賜蔡京玉帶，加童貫檢校司空，仍宣撫。

translations.literal: For recovering Taozhou, Cai Jing was given a jade belt and Tong Guan was made Honorary Sikong and retained as Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Taozhou’s recovery brought Cai Jing a jade belt and Tong Guan an honorary Sikong post while he remained Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，復諸路歲貢供奉物。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: tribute offerings from all circuits were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, annual circuit tribute offerings were restored.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，溪哥王子臧征撲哥降，復積石軍。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Zang Zheng Puge, son of the Xige prince, submitted; Jishi Army was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Xige prince’s son Zang Zheng Puge surrendered and Jishi Army was recovered.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔官蔡京子孫一人，進執政官一等。

translations.literal: Day wuchen, edict: one of Cai Jing’s descendants was ennobled and active officials were advanced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, one of Cai Jing’s kin was ennobled and serving officials gained one rank.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，以涪夷地為珍州。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yiyou: Fu Yi territory was made Zhen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, yiyou: Fu Yi land became Zhen prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以平夏城為懷德軍。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Pingxia fort was made Huaide Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Pingxia fort was made Huaide Army.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以殿中六尚、算學、太官局、翰林儀鸞司皆隸六察。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: the Six Palace Services of the Palace Directorate, the Mathematics School, the Grand Steward’s Bureau, and the Hanlin Protocol and Parasol Office were all placed under the Six Investigations.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the directorate’s six palace services, the Mathematics School, the Grand Steward’s Bureau, and the Hanlin Protocol Office were all assigned to the Six Investigations.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌，罷建僖祖殿室。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengxu: construction of the shrine hall to Emperor Xizu was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, gengxu: work on Emperor Xizu’s shrine hall was stopped.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以婉容王氏為賢妃。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Gentle Lady of the Wan rank, Lady Wang, was made Worthy Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Gentle Lady Wang was advanced to Worthy Consort.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，邢州河水溢，壞民廬舍，復被水者家。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinsi: the Yellow River overflowed at Xing prefecture, destroying commoners’ houses; families struck again by flood were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, xinsi: the Yellow River flooded at Xing, ruining homes, and families flooded again were aided.

sentences.zh: 丙申，中書侍郎梁子美罷知鄆州。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Liang Zimei was dismissed and made prefect of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Liang Zimei left the vice directorship for Yan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己亥，置保州敦宗院。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Baozhou’s Dunzong Hall was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Baozhou’s Dunzong Hall was set up.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，以林攄為中書侍郎，吏部尚書余深為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinhai: Lin Shu was made Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Minister of Personnel Yu Shen was made Left Vice Director of the Department.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, xinhai: Lin Shu became vice director of state affairs and Yu Shen left vice director.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，貶向宗回為太子少保致仕。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Xiang Zonghui was demoted to Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Xiang Zonghui was demoted to grand mentor of the heir apparent and retired.

sentences.zh: 壬申，封子植為吳國公。

translations.literal: Day renshen: the son Zhi was enfeoffed Duke of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the son Zhi was enfeoffed Duke of Wu.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，皇后王氏崩。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Empress Wang died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Empress Wang died.

sentences.zh: 削向宗回官爵。

translations.literal: Xiang Zonghui’s titles were revoked.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Zonghui was stripped of rank and enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 丙子，曲赦熙河蘭湟、秦鳳、永興軍路。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: a partial amnesty was granted on the Xihe–Lan–Huang, Qinfeng, and Yongxing circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Xihe–Lan–Huang, Qinfeng, and Yongxing received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丁未朔，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day dingwei new moon: Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingwei new moon: Venus appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上大行皇后諡曰靖和。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the late empress was given the posthumous title Tranquil Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the late empress received the posthumous title Tranquil Harmony.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，陪葬靖和皇后于永裕陵。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renyin: the Tranquil Harmony Empress was buried at Yongyu Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, renyin: the Tranquil Harmony Empress was buried at Yongyu.

sentences.zh: 是歲，同州黃河清。

translations.literal: That year the Yellow River ran clear in Tong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Yellow River cleared at Tong.

sentences.zh: 出宮女七十有七人。

translations.literal: Seventy-seven palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: Seventy-seven palace women were dismissed from service.

sentences.zh: 于闐、夏國入貢。

translations.literal: Khotan and Western Xia sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Khotan and Western Xia presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 涪夷任應舉、楊文貴，湖南徭楊再光內附。

translations.literal: The Fu Yi Ren Yingju and Yang Wengui and the Hunan Yao Yang Zaiguang submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yi leaders Ren Yingju and Yang Wengui and Hunan Yao chief Yang Zaiguang came in.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月乙卯，祔靖和皇后神主于別廟。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, day yimao: the Tranquil Harmony Empress’s spirit tablet was placed in the separate temple.
translations.idiomatic: Year 3, first month, yimao: the Tranquil Harmony Empress’s tablet was installed in the side temple.

sentences.zh: 己未，減兩京、河陽、鄭州囚罪一等，民緣園陵役者蠲其賦。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: sentences in the two capitals, Heyang, and Zheng were reduced one degree, and corvée for imperial mausoleum labor was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the two capitals, Heyang, and Zheng cut sentences one degree and remitted mausoleum corvée.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以涪夷地為承州。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Fu Yi territory was made Cheng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Fu Yi land became Cheng prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，升湟州為向德軍節度。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Huang prefecture was promoted to Xiangde Army with a military commission.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Huang was raised to Xiangde Army with a military commission.

sentences.zh: 二月丙子朔，播州楊文貴納土，以其地置遵義軍。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingzi new moon: Bozhou’s Yang Wengui surrendered his land, and his territory was made Zunyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, bingzi new moon: Yang Wengui of Bozhou surrendered his land, which became Zunyi Army.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，韓忠彥致仕。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Han Zhongyan retired.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Han Zhongyan retired.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午，立海商越界法。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingwu: a law on maritime merchants crossing boundaries was enacted.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, bingwu: a law on overseas merchants’ boundary violations was set.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，禦集英殿策進士。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: the emperor held the palace examination for presented scholars in the Hall for Gathering Excellence.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the palace examination was held in the Hall for Gathering Excellence.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔四川郡守並選內地人任之。

translations.literal: Day xinyou, edict: Sichuan prefects were all to be chosen from inland men.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Sichuan prefects were ordered chosen only from inland appointees.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，並黔南入廣西路。

translations.literal: Day renxu: southern Qian was merged into Guangxi circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, southern Qian was incorporated into Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賜禮部奏名進士及第、出身六百八十五人。

translations.literal: Day yichou: six hundred eighty-five presented scholars who passed the Ministry of Rites examination were granted passage and appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, 685 Ministry of Rites graduates received passage and appointment.

sentences.zh: 壬申，張康國卒。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Zhang Kangguo died.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Zhang Kangguo died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅，林攄罷。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuyin: Lin Shu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, wuyin: Lin Shu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以淑妃劉氏為貴妃。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Graceful Consort Liu was made Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Graceful Consort Liu was advanced to Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以鄭居中知樞密院事，吏部尚書管師仁同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Zheng Juzhong was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Minister of Personnel Guan Shiren was made Associate Director.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Zheng Juzhong became director of military affairs and Guan Shiren associate director.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以餘深為中書侍郎，兵部尚書薛昂為尚書左丞，工部尚書劉正夫為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Yu Shen was made Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Minister of War Xue Ang was made Left Vice Director, and Minister of Works Liu Zhengfu was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Yu Shen became vice director of state affairs, Xue Ang left vice director, and Liu Zhengfu right vice director.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳朔，孟翊獻所畫卦象，謂宋將中微，宜更年號、改官名、變庶事以厭之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yisi new moon: Meng Yi presented a painted hexagram image, saying the Song would wane in the middle and that the era name, official titles, and common affairs should be changed to avert it.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, yisi new moon: Meng Yi presented a painted hexagram, warning the Song would mid-wane and urging a new era name, new titles, and changed customs to ward it off.

sentences.zh: 帝不樂，詔竄遠方。

translations.literal: The emperor was displeased and ordered him exiled to a distant place.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took offense and had him banished far away.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，令辟雍宴用雅樂。

translations.literal: Day bingchen, edict: the Imperial Academy feast was to use elegant music.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the Imperial Academy feast was ordered to use elegant music.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，大雨雹。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: heavy hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, a great hailstorm struck.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以德妃喬氏為貴妃。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Virtuous Consort Qiao was made Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Virtuous Consort Qiao was advanced to Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌朔，詔修《樂書》。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiaxu new moon, edict: the Music Treatise was to be compiled.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiaxu new moon: compilation of the Music Treatise was ordered.

sentences.zh: 管師仁罷。

translations.literal: Guan Shiren was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Shiren was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，蔡京罷。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Cai Jing was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Cai Jing was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以何執中為特進、尚書左僕射兼門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: He Zhizhong was made Special Advancement Holder, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, He Zhizhong became special advancement holder, left vice director of state affairs, and concurrent vice director of the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 以瀘夷地為純、滋二州。

translations.literal: Lu Yi territory was made Chun and Zi prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yi territory was divided into Chun and Zi prefectures.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，冀州河水溢。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: the Yellow River overflowed at Ji prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the Yellow River flooded at Ji.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁未，詔謫籍人除元祐奸黨及得罪宗廟外，餘並錄用。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingwei, edict: persons on exile registers except Yuanyou faction criminals and those who had offended the imperial temples were all to be re-employed.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, dingwei: exiles except Yuanyou factionists and temple offenders were ordered re-employed.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔罷都提舉茶事司，在京令戶部、在外令轉運司主之。

translations.literal: Day bingchen, edict: the Office of the Chief Tea Monopoly Commissioner was abolished; in the capital the Ministry of Revenue and in the circuits the transport offices were to take charge.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the chief tea monopoly office was abolished and tea affairs returned to Revenue in the capital and transport commissioners in the circuits.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，封子朴為雍國公。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yiyou: the son Pu was enfeoffed Duke of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, yiyou: the son Pu was enfeoffed Duke of Yong.

sentences.zh: 己丑，嗣濮王宗漢薨。

translations.literal: Day jichou: the collateral Prince of Pu, Zonghan, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, collateral Prince of Pu Zonghan died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以仲增為開府儀同三司，封嗣濮王。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Zhongzeng was made Kaifu Yitong Sansi and enfeoffed Prince of Pu in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Zhongzeng was made Kaifu Yitong Sansi and succeeded as Prince of Pu.

sentences.zh: 丙申，升融州為清遠軍節度。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Rong prefecture was promoted to Qingyuan Army with a military commission.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Rong was raised to Qingyuan Army with a military commission.

sentences.zh: 己亥，韓忠彥薨。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Han Zhongyan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Han Zhongyan died.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，封子棣為徐國公。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guichou: the son Di was enfeoffed Duke of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, guichou: the son Di was enfeoffed Duke of Xu.

sentences.zh: 己未，賜天下州學藏書閣名「稽古」。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: all prefectural school libraries were given the name “Examining Antiquity.”
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, every prefectural school library was named “Examining Antiquity.”

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳，減六尚局供奉物。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guisi: tribute offerings of the Six Palace Services were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, guisi: the Six Palace Services’ tribute offerings were cut.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未，詔算學以黃帝為先師，風後等八人配饗，巫鹹等七十人從祀。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingwei, edict: in mathematics the Yellow Emperor was made chief teacher, eight men including Feng Hou were associated sacrifices, and seventy men including Wu Xian were secondary sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingwei: mathematics took the Yellow Emperor as chief teacher, Feng Hou and seven others as associated sacrifices, and Wu Xian and sixty-nine others as secondary sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 己巳，蔡京進封楚國公致仕，仍提舉《哲宗實錄》，朝朔望。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Cai Jing was advanced to Duke of Chu and retired, but still directed compilation of the Veritable Records of Zhezong and attended court on the first and fifteenth of the month.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Cai Jing was made Duke of Chu, retired, yet still oversaw Zhezong’s Veritable Records and came to court on new and full moons.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥，罷東南鑄夾錫錢。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jihai: casting tin-alloy coins in the southeast was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jihai: southeastern tin-alloy coin casting was stopped.

sentences.zh: 是歲，江、淮、荊、浙、福建旱，秦、鳳、階、成饑，發粟振之，蠲其賦。

translations.literal: That year Jiang, Huai, Jing, Zhe, and Fujian suffered drought; Qin, Feng, Jie, and Cheng suffered famine; grain was issued for relief and taxes remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year drought struck Jiang, Huai, Jing, Zhe, and Fujian and famine Qin, Feng, Jie, and Cheng; grain was distributed and taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 陝州、同州黃河清。

translations.literal: The Yellow River ran clear in Shaan and Tong prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River cleared in Shaan and Tong.

sentences.zh: 闍婆、占城、夏國入貢。

translations.literal: Java, Champa, and Western Xia sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Java, Champa, and Western Xia presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 瀘州夷王募弱內附。

translations.literal: The Lu chieftain Wang Moruo submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: Lu chieftain Wang Moruo came in.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月癸卯，罷改鑄當十錢。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, day guimao: recoinage of ten-count cash was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Year 4, first month, guimao: recoinage of ten-count cash was stopped.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔士庶拜僧者，論以大不恭。

translations.literal: Day xinyou, edict: commoners and gentry who bowed to monks were to be prosecuted for great irreverence.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, gentry and commoners bowing to monks were to be charged with great irreverence.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，夏國入貢。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Western Xia sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Western Xia presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午朔，禁然頂、煉臂、刺血、斷指。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengwu new moon: tonsuring the crown, cauterizing the arm, bloodletting, and finger-cutting were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, gengwu new moon: tonsuring the crown, arm cautery, bloodletting, and finger-cutting were banned.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，罷京西錢監。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Jingxi coin offices were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Jingxi coin offices were abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔自今以賞進秩者毋過中奉大夫。

translations.literal: Day jiashen, edict: from now those advanced in rank by reward were not to exceed Senior Supporter of the Court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, reward promotions were capped below Senior Supporter of the Court.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以余深為門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Yu Shen was made Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Yu Shen became vice director of the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 資政殿學士張商英為中書侍郎，戶部尚書侯蒙同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance Zhang Shangying was made Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Minister of Revenue Hou Meng was made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shangying became vice director of state affairs and Hou Meng associate director of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，罷河東、河北、京東鑄夾錫鐵錢。

translations.literal: Day renchen: casting tin-alloy iron coins in Hedong, Hebei, and Jingdong was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Hedong, Hebei, and Jingdong tin-alloy iron coin casting was stopped.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，募饑民補禁卒。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengzi: famine victims were recruited to fill the palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, gengzi: famine refugees were enlisted as palace guards.

sentences.zh: 詔醫學生併入太醫局，算入太史局，書入翰林書藝局，畫入翰林畫圖局，學官等並罷。

translations.literal: Edict: medical students were merged into the Imperial Medical Bureau, mathematicians into the Imperial Astronomical Bureau, calligraphers into the Hanlin Calligraphy Bureau, and painters into the Hanlin Painting Bureau; their instructors were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Medical students joined the Imperial Medical Bureau, mathematicians the Astronomical Bureau, calligraphers the Hanlin Calligraphy Bureau, and painters the Hanlin Painting Bureau; their school officers were abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，敕所在振恤流民。

translations.literal: Day jiayin, edict: wherever they were, relief was to be extended to displaced persons.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, localities were ordered to relieve displaced persons.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔：罪廢人稍加甄敘，能安分守者，不俟滿歲，各與敘進，以責來效。

translations.literal: Day guihai, edict: the demoted were to receive gradual rehabilitation; those who could keep their place without offense need not wait a full year before advancement, so as to demand future merit.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the demoted were to be gradually rehabilitated; the dutiful could advance before a year was out to call forth later service.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，賜上舍生十五人及第。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: fifteen Upper College students were granted passage.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, fifteen Upper College students passed the examination.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔上書邪下等人可依無過人例，今後改官升任並免檢舉。

translations.literal: Day wuchen, edict: heterodox memorialists of lower rank might follow the rule for the blameless; hereafter promotion and transfer were exempt from impeachment review.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, lower-rank heterodox memorialists were treated like the blameless; future promotions and transfers need not pass impeachment review.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，班樂尺於天下。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jimao: the standard pitch-pipe was distributed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jimao: the standard pitch-pipe was issued empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 癸未，蔡京上《哲宗實錄》。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Cai Jing submitted the Veritable Records of Zhezong.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Cai Jing submitted Zhezong’s Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 丙申，立感生帝壇。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: the altar to the Spirit-Generating Emperor was established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the Spirit-Generating Emperor altar was established.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔修《哲宗史》。

translations.literal: Day dingyou, edict: the History of Zhezong was to be compiled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, compilation of the History of Zhezong was ordered.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅，停僧牒三年。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renyin: issuance of monk certificates was suspended for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, renyin: monk certificates were suspended for three years.

sentences.zh: 丁未，彗出奎、婁。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: a comet appeared in Kui and Lou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, a comet appeared in Kui and Lou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，立詞學兼茂科。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: the Palatial Writings and Comprehensive Excellence examination was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the Palatial Writings and Comprehensive Excellence examination was instituted.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔以彗見，避殿減膳，令侍從官直言指陳闕失。

translations.literal: Day bingchen, edict: because of the comet, the emperor left the hall, reduced his meals, and ordered attendant officials to speak frankly on faults.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the comet brought withdrawal from court, reduced meals, and orders for attendants to speak frankly on failings.

sentences.zh: 戊午，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: an amnesty was granted throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the empire was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，改廣西黔南路為廣南西路。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Guangxi’s Qiannan circuit was renamed Guangnan West circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Guangxi’s Qiannan circuit was renamed Guangnan West.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，治廣西妄言拓地罪，追貶帥臣王祖道為昭信軍節度副使。

translations.literal: Day guihai: the crime of reckless territorial expansion in Guangxi was prosecuted; circuit commander Wang Zudao was posthumously demoted to military deputy commissioner of Zhaoxin Army.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Guangxi’s reckless expansion was tried and commander Wang Zudao posthumously demoted to Zhaoxin deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲子，貶蔡京為太子少保。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Cai Jing was demoted to Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Cai Jing was demoted to grand mentor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，餘深罷。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Yu Shen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Yu Shen was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 六月庚午，禦殿復膳。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengwu: the emperor resumed meals in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengwu: the emperor resumed hall meals.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以張商英為尚書右僕射兼中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Zhang Shangying was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Zhang Shangying became right vice director of state affairs and concurrent vice director of the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，復向宗回為開府儀同三司、漢東郡王。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Xiang Zonghui was restored as Kaifu Yitong Sansi and Prince of Handong commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Xiang Zonghui was restored as Kaifu Yitong Sansi and Prince of Handong.

sentences.zh: 乙未，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，薛昂罷。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Xue Ang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Xue Ang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，復罷方田。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinchou: the square-field system was again abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, xinchou: the square-field system was abolished again.

sentences.zh: 戊申，封子㮙為冀國公。

translations.literal: Day wushen: the son Kui was enfeoffed Duke of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the son Kui was enfeoffed Duke of Ji.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥，以劉正夫為中書侍郎，侯蒙為尚書左丞，翰林學士承旨鄧洵仁為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yihai: Liu Zhengfu was made Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Hou Meng was made Left Vice Director, and Hanlin Academician-in-Chief Deng Xunren was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, yihai: Liu Zhengfu became vice director of state affairs, Hou Meng left vice director, and Deng Xunren right vice director.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，省內外冗官。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: redundant offices inside and outside the capital were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, redundant capital and field offices were cut.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以資政殿學士吳居厚為門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance Wu Juhou was made Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Wu Juhou became vice director of the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，行內外學官選試法。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the selection examination law for inside and outside school officers was implemented.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the selection examination for inside and outside school officers took effect.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛丑，詔諸路事有不便於民者，監司條奏之。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day xinchou, edict: wherever a circuit matter was inconvenient for the people, commissioners were to memorialize it item by item.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, xinchou: circuit commissioners were to list item by item any local matter hard on the people.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，改陵井監為仙井監。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Lingjing prefecture’s office was renamed Xianjing prefecture’s office.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Lingjing prefecture’s office was renamed Xianjing.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔戒朋黨。

translations.literal: Day xinyou, edict: faction cliques were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, faction cliques were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 以張閣知杭州，兼領花石綱。

translations.literal: Zhang Ge was made prefect of Hangzhou and concurrently directed the Floral Stone Fleet.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Ge became Hangzhou prefect and concurrently headed the Floral Stone Fleet.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingyin new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, bingyin new moon: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，立貴妃鄭氏為皇后。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingyou: Noble Consort Zheng was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, dingyou: Noble Consort Zheng was installed as empress.

sentences.zh: 鄭居中罷。

translations.literal: Zheng Juzhong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Juzhong was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Venus appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 以吳居厚知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Wu Juhou was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Juhou became director of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑朔，朝景靈宮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yichou new moon: the emperor attended the Hall of Imperial Brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, yichou new moon: the emperor attended the Hall of Imperial Brilliance.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，饗太廟。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: the imperial ancestors were feasted in the Imperial Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the imperial ancestors received offering in the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，祀昊天上帝於圜丘，赦天下，改明年元。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: August Heaven, Sovereign on High, was sacrificed to at the Round Mound; the realm was amnestied and the next year’s era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, August Heaven was sacrificed to at the Round Mound; the empire was amnestied and the next year’s era name changed.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，罷拱州為襄邑縣。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Gong prefecture was abolished and made Xiangyi county.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Gong prefecture was abolished and made Xiangyi county.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌，改諡靖和皇后為惠恭。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengxu: the Tranquil Harmony Empress’s posthumous title was changed to Gracious and Respectful.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, gengxu: the Tranquil Harmony Empress was renamed Gracious and Respectful posthumously.

sentences.zh: 是歲，夔州江水溢。

translations.literal: That year the Yangtze overflowed at Kui prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Yangtze flooded at Kui.

sentences.zh: 海水清。

translations.literal: The sea ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: The sea ran clear.

sentences.zh: 出宮女四百八十六人。

translations.literal: Four hundred eighty-six palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: Four hundred eighty-six palace women were dismissed from service.
