sentences.zh: 南丹州首領莫公晟內附。

translations.literal: The Nandan chieftain Mo Gongsheng submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: Nandan chief Mo Gongsheng came in.

sentences.zh: 政和元年春正月己巳，以賢妃王氏為德妃。

translations.literal: Zhenghe year 1, spring, first month, day jisi: Worthy Consort Wang was made Virtuous Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenghe 1, first month, jisi: Worthy Consort Wang was advanced to Virtuous Consort.

sentences.zh: 壬申，毀京師淫祠一千三十八區。

translations.literal: Day renshen: one thousand thirty-eight licentious shrines in the capital were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, 1,038 licentious shrines in the capital were torn down.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，封子栱為定國公。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the son Gong was enfeoffed Duke of Ding.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the son Gong was enfeoffed Duke of Ding.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，廢白、龔二州。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Bai and Gong prefectures were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Bai and Gong prefectures were abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔百官厲名節。

translations.literal: Day renchen, edict: all officials were to cultivate integrity.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, officials were ordered to cultivate integrity.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，冊皇后。

translations.literal: Second month, day renyin: the empress was installed.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, renyin: the empress was installed.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔陝西、河東復鑄夾錫錢。

translations.literal: Day yisi, edict: Shaanxi and Hedong were again to cast tin-alloy coins.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Shaanxi and Hedong were again ordered to cast tin-alloy coins.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以太子少師鄭紳為開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zheng Shen was made Kaifu Yitong Sansi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Zheng Shen was made Kaifu Yitong Sansi.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，詔監司督州縣長吏勸民增植桑柘，課其多寡為賞罰。

translations.literal: Third month, day jisi, edict: commissioners were to urge prefectural and county chiefs to encourage the people to plant mulberry and catalpa, with rewards and punishments according to quantity.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jisi: commissioners were to press prefects and magistrates to urge mulberry and catalpa planting and reward or punish by quantity.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以吏部尚書王襄同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Minister of Personnel Wang Xiang was made Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Wang Xiang became associate director of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，罷陝西、河東鑄夾錫錢。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yimao: casting tin-alloy coins in Shaanxi and Hedong was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, yimao: Shaanxi and Hedong tin-alloy coin casting was stopped.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，慮囚。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 立守令勸農黜陟法。

translations.literal: A law for promoting and demoting prefects and magistrates who encouraged or neglected agriculture was enacted.
translations.idiomatic: A law promoting and demoting prefects and magistrates by their encouragement of farming was enacted.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以淮南旱，降囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: because of drought in Huainan, sentences were reduced one degree and those below penal servitude were released.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Huainan drought cut sentences one degree and freed those below penal servitude.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥，詔四川羨余錢物歸左藏庫。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guihai, edict: Sichuan’s surplus funds and goods were to go to the Left Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, guihai: Sichuan surplus funds and goods were ordered into the Left Treasury.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，改當十錢為當三。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: ten-count cash was changed to three-count cash.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, ten-count cash was revalued to three-count.

sentences.zh: 己卯，東南有星晝隕。

translations.literal: Day jimao: a star fell in daylight in the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, a star fell by day in the southeast.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，解池生紅鹽。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: red salt formed at Jie Pool.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, red salt formed at Jie Pool.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅，復蔡京為太子少師。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiayin: Cai Jing was restored as Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiayin: Cai Jing was restored as grand mentor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，以疾愈，赦天下。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renshen: because the emperor’s illness had passed, the realm was amnestied.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renshen: recovery from illness brought an empire-wide amnesty.

sentences.zh: 癸未，廢平、從二州為砦。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Ping and Cong prefectures were abolished and made forts.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Ping and Cong prefectures were abolished and made forts.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，復蔡京為太子太師。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yiwei: Cai Jing was restored as Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, yiwei: Cai Jing was restored as grand preceptor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，張商英罷。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Zhang Shangying was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Zhang Shangying was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔：「監司部內官吏，一歲中有犯罪至三人以上，雖不及三人而或有曾薦舉者，罪及監司。

translations.literal: Day wuwu, edict: “Within a commissioner’s jurisdiction, if in one year three or more officials commit crimes—or though fewer than three, some had been recommended—the commissioner is also liable.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, an edict held commissioners liable when three or more subordinates offended in a year, or when fewer than three included men they had recommended.

sentences.zh: 」九月戊寅，王襄罷。

translations.literal: ” Ninth month, day wuyin: Wang Xiang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuyin: Wang Xiang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，封子栻為黃國公。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the son Shi was enfeoffed Duke of Huang.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the son Shi was enfeoffed Duke of Huang.

sentences.zh: 是月，鄭允中、童貫使遼，以李良嗣來，良嗣獻取燕之策，詔賜姓趙。

translations.literal: That month Zheng Yunzhong and Tong Guan were envoys to Liao; Li Liangsi came in their stead, presented a plan to take Yan, and was ordered granted the surname Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zheng Yunzhong and Tong Guan went to Liao; Li Liangsi came in return, offered a plan to seize Yan, and was granted the surname Zhao.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，以用事之臣多險躁朋比，下詔申儆。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinmao: because many powerful ministers were dangerous, impetuous, and factional, an edict was issued as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, xinmao: many powerful ministers being reckless and cliquish, a warning edict was issued.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，封昭化軍節度使宗粹為信安郡王。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Military Commissioner of Zhaohua Army Zongcui was enfeoffed Prince of Xin’an commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Zongcui of Zhaohua Army was enfeoffed Prince of Xin’an.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，貶張商英為崇信軍節度副使。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Zhang Shangying was demoted to military deputy commissioner of Chongxin Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Zhang Shangying was demoted to Chongxin deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一月任戌，以上書邪等及曾經入籍人並不許試學官。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renxu: heterodox memorialists and those once entered on registers were all forbidden to test for school office.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, renxu: heterodox memorialists and those once on faction registers were barred from school-office examinations.

sentences.zh: 丙子，封子榛為福國公。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the son Zhen was enfeoffed Duke of Fu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the son Zhen was enfeoffed Duke of Fu.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，詔台諫以直道核是非，毋憚大吏，毋比近習。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiyou, edict: censors and remonstrators were to judge right and wrong by the straight Way, not fear great officials, and not side with favorites.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiyou: censors and remonstrators were to judge by the straight Way, fear no great officer, and not side with favorites.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，廢鎮州，升瓊州為靖海軍。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Zhen prefecture was abolished and Qiong prefecture was promoted to Jinghai Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Zhen prefecture was abolished and Qiong was raised to Jinghai Army.

sentences.zh: 是歲，虔州芝草生。

translations.literal: That year lingzhi fungus grew at Qian prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That year lingzhi grew at Qian.

sentences.zh: 蔡州瑞麥連野。

translations.literal: At Cai prefecture auspicious wheat covered the fields.
translations.idiomatic: At Cai, auspicious wheat spread across the fields.

sentences.zh: 河南府嘉禾生，野蠶成繭。

translations.literal: At Henan prefecture fine grain grew and wild silkworms formed cocoons.
translations.idiomatic: At Henan, fine grain appeared and wild silkworms spun cocoons.

sentences.zh: 出宮女八十人。

translations.literal: Eighty palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: Eighty palace women were dismissed from service.

sentences.zh: 交趾、夏國入貢。

translations.literal: Annam and Western Xia sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Annam and Western Xia presented tribute.
